_provenance.note: Live test-mode capture of the settlement recon endpoint. The account returned an EMPTY collection - it holds no data of this kind, so this file records reachability and the envelope shape only, not the item shape.
_provenance.why_this_matters: ADR-007 lives or dies here: only settled payment rows with NON-ZERO tax can distinguish a GST-inclusive fee from an MDR-only one. Rows with tax == 0 satisfy both identities and prove nothing.
